goal: Module One of the course text, which is compulsory written question one and the whole of objective test 1: the analyst, the life cycle and the methodologies. Every one of the thirty test 1 questions lives inside these lessons. Finish on the practical, choosing and justifying a methodology.
drill: The methodology selection table is the single most examined thing in this module. Say it back from memory before you move on.

goal: Module Two of the course text, compulsory written question two and the heaviest diagram work: fact-finding, use cases, data flow diagrams and entity relationship diagrams. Draw each diagram by hand as you meet it, then the practical; this is a drawing paper.
drill: Twenty-one of test 2's thirty questions sit here, and ten of them are matching. Learn definitions BESIDE their names, not names alone.

goal: Module Three of the course text, compulsory written question three: objects, class diagrams and the behavioural diagrams, then the hotel booking practical drawn four ways. Then sleep, because the paper is at ten tomorrow.
drill: Include against extend, aggregation against composition, sequence against collaboration. Three pairs, and all three get asked.

window: Wednesday, 6:00 am to 9:00 am, before the paper at 10
goal: Both past papers, every question, in your book: the list points written in full and each diagram sketched, then the model answer. Then the cram sheet. These three hours decide the diagram marks, so draw, do not read.
drill: If time is short, do the 2025/2026 paper first; it is the most recent. The trap list in the last fifteen minutes, then leave for the hall.
